atoms.a: ssml: Lucia buys ten pieces of fruit. <break time='1000ms'/>Two of them are oranges. <break time='1000ms'/>Four of them are apples. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are bananas. <break time='1000ms'/>How many bananas does Lucia buy? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.

ssml: Elijah’s dad owns nine farm animals. <break time='1000ms'/>Three of them are goats. <break time='1000ms'/>One of them is a horse. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are pigs. <break time='1000ms'/>How many pigs does Elijah’s dad own? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.

ssml: Iris hands out eight different drinks. <break time='1000ms'/>Four of them are juice cartons. <break time='1000ms'/>Two of them are water bottles. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are cups of lemonade. <break time='1000ms'/>How many cups of lemonade does Iris hand out? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.

ssml: Casper is growing eleven patches of crops in his garden. <break time='1000ms'/>Two of them are pumpkin patches. <break time='1000ms'/>Three of them are carrot patches. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are tomato patches. <break time='1000ms'/>How many tomato patches is Casper growing? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.

ssml: Ramona plays with her seven toys. <break time='1000ms'/>Two of them are teddy bears. <break time='1000ms'/>Two of them are toy trucks. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are toy trains. <break time='1000ms'/>How many toy trains is Ramona playing with? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.

ssml: Dohyun has twelve items in his pencil case. <break time='1000ms'/>Four of them are pens. <break time='1000ms'/>One of them is a pair of scissors. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are pencils. <break time='1000ms'/>How many pencils does Dohyun have? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.

ssml: Freya hid twelve Easter eggs in the garden. <break time='1000ms'/>Four of them are blue eggs. <break time='1000ms'/>Two of them are red eggs. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are yellow eggs. <break time='1000ms'/>How many yellow eggs did Freya hide? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.

ssml: Niran planted thirteen flowers on his balcony. <break time='1000ms'/>Three of them are blue violets. <break time='1000ms'/>Three of them are pink tulips. <break time='1000ms'/>The rest are white daisies. <break time='1000ms'/>How many white daisies did Niran plant? <break time='1000ms'/>Write your answer in the box.
